Solid drifting game.

PROS:

- Good physics
- Extensive tuning that actually has an impact on your car
- Every car feels different to drive and will require unique tuning to get it to feel right depending on upgrades made
- Very easy to jump in to a multiplayer lobby and drift around with friends
- Controller/Wheel support

CONS:

- Car sounds are average at best
- Multiplayer can be a little buggy at times if drifting in tandem the car placement can be slightly off causing you to hit the other car
- Large Russian player base means there is somewhat of a language barrier when playing online…
